title: Bookkeeping commit: null stdin + no-gpg-sign, linked-worktree test, ceiling-guarded not_a_repo test
action: Three review P3s (close-lands-bookkeeping-20260810 P3-1/P3-3/P3-4), all in close.rs. (P3-1) run_git sets stdin to null; the bookkeeping `git commit` invocation adds --no-gpg-sign so a commit.gpgsign=true repo with a tty pinentry can never hang close (chosen policy: bee's own bookkeeping commit is unsigned; the test fixture's `git config commit.gpgsign false` defense becomes redundant but may stay). (P3-3) New test: create a repo, `git worktree add` a linked checkout (whose .git is a FILE), dirty tracked .bee there, run the bookkeeping path with that root, assert committed:true on the linked worktree's branch — proves the rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree detection the spec calls out. (P3-4) Harden non_repo_root_reports_not_a_repo_and_close_stays_green: scoped env guard sets GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES to the tempdir's parent for the duration (restore previous value on drop), so a TMPDIR under a real git checkout cannot make the test stage into that repo. All existing tests stay green.

truths: bookkeeping commit passes --no-gpg-sign and run_git spawns git with stdin null
a linked worktree root commits its .bee bookkeeping in the suite, not only by hand
the not_a_repo test cannot stage into an enclosing repo regardless of TMPDIR

artifacts.substantive: fixes plus tests, no TODO stubs

trace.outcome: run_git stdin null + --no-gpg-sign on bookkeeping commit; linked-worktree branch test; GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES guard on not_a_repo test
